text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, after classes have finished, I
hear voices
coming from inside the gym.
I peek inside and
find...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Hey! Pay more attention to where the
spotlight is
shining. And you're walking
too early too.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Haaah ha ha ha! I do apologize! I dazzle
so
spectacularly that mere lighting
escapes the eye!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Focus on moving the spotlight faster,
Doto.
You're not keepin' up with Opera
O.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
R-right! I'll do my best!
Be faster! Be
faster!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Huh?!
Hell no! Don't get any weird
ideas!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Actually, T.M. Opera O is the only
person up on
the stage. Air Shakur must
be helping backstage
with the sound
and lighting.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Wishing to capture me in the dazzling
cage of the
spotlight is the most natural
thing in the world!
'Tis a fearsome thing,
this charm of mine, capable
of bringing
the entire world to its knees!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Th-that's for sure! You've even got
Shakur so
dazzled and impressed that
she's helping out.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Wrong. Dead wrong. How many times do
I have
to say it?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
You don't have to bother over every
little detail.
Damn...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Fine. If you're that curious, just watch the full rehearsal. It's about time we factor in the audience factor anyway.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Get ready, you two. It's time to begin
the code
review process.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Their opera is so incredibly well put
together, I
can hardly believe it was
created by just three
people.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Alas, I can never be satisfied for even a
moment,
no matter how glorious. The
paragon of beauty
that is myself is a
thing that must be shared with
as many
as possible!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...Three, two, one.
Aaand, fade out in
ten...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
T.M. Opera O moves across the stage
illuminated
by a laser-focused spotlight,
each step
resounding through the space
as if struck on
stone.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In the next instant, a vast ocean appears.
A flood
of lights and the sound of
crashing waves make
the empty stage
suddenly come alive.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Time, I command thee stand still! Behold
my
beauty!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: And now, fade to black.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: There you have it. Thoughts?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Right? I meticulously calculated every
aspect so
as to create a feeling of
immersion, pulling the
audience directly
into the world on stage.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
What a masterpiece! With your
direction, we've
somehow managed to
draw out my radiant charm
even
further—exactly as one would polish a

gemstone!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I had no idea you could do that with
sound and
lighting. You really helped us
out!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I didn't do any of this to help you. I just
wanted to
prove a theory I had.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to test if my logic would prevail
even in
the chaotic world of the arts. I
wish you'd all get
that through your
heads.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...Tch. Now, that's enough useless
blabber. Let's
keep running tests until
it's time for the real
performance.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It appears the real reason Air Shakur has
decided
to help with the show isn't due
to kindness, but
rather the desire to
prove a theory. All the same...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It appears the real reason Air Shakur has
decided
to help with the show isn't due
to kindness, but
rather the desire to
prove a theory. All the same...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Regardless of intentions, pulling off this
level of
perfection is no ordinary feat. I
tell her it seems
she's put in no small
effort, but...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Spare me the cliches. Putting forth the
effort
necessary to achieve a goal should
go without
saying.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
B-but... you've come to so many
rehearsals. It
really feels like we
accomplished this together.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Actually, well, I know what you must be
thinking!
What right does someone as
useless as me have
to say that, right?
Sorry!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Sigh. For the love of...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, it turned out all right. If we can
keep up
this quality until opening day,
I'll call you back to
reprise your role as
an audience member.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's not easy to tell, but Air Shakur seems

somewhat pleased.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Well, yeah. Even if I tried to back out
now,
Doto'd never give me a moment's
peace.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Not only that, I would come to recruit
you once
again! It's rare to find such a
magnificent
backstage talent! I wouldn't
dream of letting you
slip through my
fingers.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
See? Sticking it out to the end is the
logical
choice. I've factored that in from
the very
beginning.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: No other reason.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Air Shakur seeing this play through until
the end
admittedly shows a bit of her
caring side. Or at
least that's how it
seems to me!
